data.message: I commit to request 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Please state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
